 0 Share 2026년 11월 5일 목 오전 8:30 UTC Bournemouth fans have another European night on to look forward to as the Cherries travel to the Czech Republic to face Sparta Prague.
 BBC Radio Solent's Bournemouth commentator Jordan Clark met some travelling fans who have been soaking up the atmosphere in Prague.
